about: One grip per weapon TYPE (docs/anim/GRIP_STANDARD.md). section: the grip's half-extents about its centre line, mm in life (round: half_w = half_d = the radius; flat: half_w across the flats' long way, half_d toward the palm); length: the reference grip's usable length, mm; grip_from_guard: mm from the guard's end of the grip down to the grip point (the anchor_grip origin, the fist's pocket point); glove: mm a glove's thickness adds round the fist (0: the fitted fists are on her skin and the ranger's glove as fitted). from: the piece the type's fist is fitted and judged on. Written by tools/assets/grip_conform.py measure.

Dagger.fist: keyed.py WRAP daggers, WeaponSockets DaggerAtR (left: PocketL, mirrored)

Crossbow.from: crossbow (its pistol grip, modelled in-house: tools/assets/crossbow_grip.py, 18 October)
Crossbow.fist: keyed.py WRAP crossbow, WeaponSockets CrossbowAtR (Arms.Seat pistol path, PistolSeat)

Axe.from: PROVISIONAL: no fist is fitted on an axe (AxeAtR not live: viking_axe's 58 x 42 mm haft is past any fist); 32 x 27.3 mm, the staff's depth, about the 30 across WeaponSockets asks; the first axe fit (fistfit.py axe --fit on the conformed haft) sets it
Axe.fist: none yet (keyed.py WRAP axe, WeaponSockets AxeAtR when fitted)

mage_staff.why: the bead strand hangs by the shaft; the anchor is on the shaft (the rule)

longsword.why: a wire-wrapped grip: its rings' radii jump 15-22 mm, so the band is read off its profile
